skills.name: dart-add-unit-test
skills.rule: Write isolated, deterministic unit tests for business logic using package:test, arranging prerequisites, acting on target behavior, and asserting outputs with clear group/test hierarchy.

skills.name: dart-build-cli-app
skills.rule: Architect CLI tools using package:args with structured exit codes, stream routing (stdout vs stderr), and subprocess management while avoiding premature exit(N) calls to allow standard cleanup.

skills.name: dart-collect-coverage
skills.rule: Collect code coverage with test execution and format LCOV reports using package:coverage while properly ignoring generated and macro code using coverage directives.

skills.name: dart-fix-runtime-errors
skills.rule: Diagnose runtime stack traces and static analysis warnings systematically using strong typing, soundness rules, and null-safety principles before verifying fixes via hot reload or targeted test runs.

skills.name: dart-generate-test-mocks
skills.rule: Decouple external dependencies in unit tests by generating type-safe mock objects via package:mockito annotations (@GenerateMocks) and build_runner.

skills.name: dart-migrate-to-checks-package
skills.rule: Migrate legacy package:matcher assertions (expect) to expressive, type-safe, fluent assertions using package:checks (check()).

skills.name: dart-resolve-package-conflicts
skills.rule: Resolve pub dependency graph conflicts systematically using dependency overrides, semantic version alignment, and auditing without arbitrarily weakening required version bounds.

skills.name: dart-run-static-analysis
skills.rule: Enforce strict zero-warning policy across the codebase by running dart analyze and applying mechanical fixes with dart fix --apply before committing.

skills.name: dart-setup-ffi-assets
skills.rule: Compile and package C/C++ dynamic or static libraries into Dart Code Assets using Native Assets hook scripts (hook/build.dart and hook/link.dart) via package:hooks and package:native_toolchain_c.

skills.name: dart-use-doc-examples
skills.rule: Maintain verified API documentation code examples by referencing external testable Dart files using {@example} directives paired with #region and #hide tags.

skills.name: dart-use-ffigen
skills.rule: Generate robust, type-safe C/Objective-C FFI bindings automatically using package:ffigen configuration instead of writing manual dart:ffi boilerplate.

skills.name: dart-use-path-package
skills.rule: Manipulate file and directory paths exclusively using package:path functions (p.join, p.normalize, p.split) rather than raw string concatenation to ensure cross-platform compatibility.

skills.name: dart-use-pattern-matching
skills.rule: Utilize Dart 3 patterns, switch expressions, and destructuring for exhaustive algebraic type checking, polymorphic JSON parsing, and concise control flow.

skills.name: dart-use-primary-constructors
skills.rule: Adopt Dart 3.13+ concise primary constructors in class headers (with field parameter modifier declarations) and abbreviated class-body constructors for modern, concise class declarations.

skills.name: dart-write-documentation
skills.rule: Write concise, third-person active doc comments (///) summarizing behavior in the first sentence according to Effective Dart documentation guidelines without redundant type descriptions or conversational filler.

skills.name: flutter-add-integration-test
skills.rule: Automate end-to-end user workflows using package:integration_test and WidgetTester driver logic to verify whole-app behavior across realistic device environments.

skills.name: flutter-add-widget-preview
skills.rule: Provide fast UI component design feedback by creating widget preview instances using package:previews/previews.dart for isolated UI state inspection.

skills.name: flutter-add-widget-test
skills.rule: Verify UI component rendering, state changes, and user gesture interactions (tapping, scrolling, typing) in isolation using WidgetTester and finder assertions.

skills.name: flutter-apply-architecture-best-practices
skills.rule: Maintain clean separation of concerns by partitioning code into presentation (UI), state/logic, data repositories, and remote/local data sources.

skills.name: flutter-build-responsive-layout
skills.rule: Design responsive interfaces that adapt seamlessly to varying viewport sizes using layout constraints (LayoutBuilder, MediaQuery, Expanded, Flexible) rather than hardcoded pixel dimensions.

skills.name: flutter-fix-layout-issues
skills.rule: Diagnose and resolve layout overflow and unbounded constraint errors systematically using Flutter Inspector diagnostics, flexible sizing, and scrollable containers.

skills.name: flutter-implement-json-serialization
skills.rule: Implement type-safe manual JSON serialization using dart:convert with explicit type casting in fromJson and toJson model methods.

skills.name: flutter-setup-declarative-routing
skills.rule: Configure declarative, URL-driven app navigation with deep linking support using go_router integrated into MaterialApp.router.

skills.name: flutter-setup-localization
skills.rule: Internationalize Flutter applications by defining translation keys in ARB files, configuring l10n.yaml, and generating strongly typed AppLocalizations delegates.

skills.name: flutter-use-http-package
skills.rule: Execute REST network requests using package:http with typed Uri parsing, explicit header injection, status code validation, and isolate-offloaded background JSON parsing.
